subject.title: [Feature]: Sessions page polish: dot + label status, Runtime column into the row drawer

question: Should the Sessions roster adopt the requested dot-plus-label status treatment and move Runtime from the table into the row drawer now?
rationale: The current behavior is not broken by an established contract; this is a protected, user-visible UI-polish choice on a recently redesigned operator surface.

options.title: Approve narrow polish
options.body: Implement the requested visual and layout change in the Sessions view with focused tests and screenshot proof.

options.title: Keep current roster
options.body: Leave Runtime and the existing badge treatment in the table, and close or defer this polish direction explicitly.

options.body: Wait for or fold in the related status-semantics work before changing status presentation.
